decisions.reason: Construction site dumper fits the firm's construction portfolio and retains option value as demand remains uncertain but keeping costs are moderate.
Inclined furniture lift is a niche option with low keeping cost and unresolved demand, so keep open.
Inclined building material lift complements existing construction and lifting capabilities, with low cost to maintain the option.
Truck-mounted lift variant has higher complexity but could capture mobile niche; keep while monitoring.
